name: hats
description: Hands a resume note, saved with the anchor command (/hats:anchor), to the next Claude Code session: back to the same session after /clear, and as a list of notes when a new session starts in the same folder. With Claude Code's memory on, it writes the note and a resume-index.md into the project's memory folder, creates MEMORY.md with a line pointing to that index when there is none, and asks the session to add the line to an existing MEMORY.md. A hook after every Read records a session that reads a saved note — its Claude process id and start time, its session id and the time of the read — in state/handoff/taken in Claude Code's settings folder, so that another session reading the same note is warned. A part that runs inside Claude Code watches each session's context window: past a warning threshold it asks the model to tell the user, and at the end of a turn past a save threshold it runs /hats:anchor by itself and checks the save; it takes the thresholds from window-thresholds.json in the Hats folder (45% and 55% without it) and writes each session's stage to session-thresholds/<session id>.json there.
